markdownEnumDescriptions: `nightly` updates are shipped daily (extension updates automatically by downloading artifacts directly from GitHub), they contain cutting-edge features and latest bug fixes.
rune.updates.channel.markdownDescription: Choose `nightly` updates to get the latest features and bug fixes every day.

rune.updates.askBeforeDownload.description: Whether to ask for permission before downloading any files from the Internet.

rune.typing.continueCommentsOnNewline.markdownDescription: Whether to prefix newlines after comments with the corresponding comment prefix.

rune.server.cargoPackage.title: Cargo Package
rune.server.cargoPackage.markdownDescription: Set the extension to use the given cargo package to run the language server, rather than a downloaded rune-languageserver.

rune.server.cargoBinary.title: Cargo Binary
rune.server.cargoBinary.markdownDescription: Set the extension to use the given cargo binary to run the language server. If left empty, the last binary built is used.

rune.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to rune-languageserver executable (will be downloaded by default). If this is set, then `#rune.updates.channel#` setting is not used

rune.server.extraEnv.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables that will be passed to the rune-languageserver executable. Useful for passing e.g. `RUNE_LOG_FILE` for debugging.

rune.trace.extension.description: Enable logging of VS Code extensions itself.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
